payload.core_mechanism_summary: Reduces each number by dividing out all square factors of primes (up to 1000 squared), then groups identical reduced values to count frequencies; d2 = max group size, d1 = max of d2 and sum of even-sized groups plus group of 1.
payload.rationale: The solution implicitly uses parity of prime exponents (a bitmask-like concept) to define adjacency groups. Subtype 'bit_bitmask_dp' fits as it involves bitmask representation, though no DP; family 'bit_manipulation' matches candidate_families.
